type compositionFixture struct {
	repo             *sqliterepo.SyntheticApprovalRepository
	auth             *auth.Service
	token            string
	router, ordinary *gin.Engine
	server           *Server
}

// The fixture transport supplies server execution identity, never request data.
type compositionTransport struct {
	BackendClient
	resolver *mcpscope.Resolver
	binding  ownanswer.OwnAnswerBinding
}

func (c compositionTransport) RequestPayload(ctx context.Context, action string, payload, result interface{}) error {
	b := c.binding
	ctx, err := c.resolver.Scope(ctx, b.TaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx = mcpscope.WithPrincipal(ctx, mcpscope.Principal{CallerTaskID: b.TaskID, CallerSessionID: b.SessionID, WorkspaceID: b.WorkspaceID, Surface: mcpprofile.SurfaceKanbanTask})
	ctx = streams.WithMCPExecutionContext(ctx, streams.MCPExecutionContext{TaskID: b.TaskID, SessionID: b.SessionID, ExecutionID: "synthetic-execution"})
	return c.BackendClient.RequestPayload(ctx, action, payload, result)
}

func newCompositionFixture(t *testing.T) *compositionFixture {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	db, err := kdb.OpenSQLite(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "synthetic.db"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	pool := sqlx.NewDb(db, "sqlite3")
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, pool.Close()) })
	r, err := sqliterepo.NewWithDB(pool, pool, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	users, cleanup, err := userstore.Provide(pool, pool)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, cleanup()) })
	as, err := authstore.New(pool, pool)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cfg := &config.Config{}
	cfg.Features.Auth = true
	cfg.Auth.SessionTTLHours = 1
	a, err := auth.NewService(ctx, auth.Deps{Cfg: cfg, Store: as, Users: users})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	u, token, err := a.Setup(ctx, "synthetic-composition@example.test", "synthetic-password-123", "Synthetic admin", "", "")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = messagequeue.NewSQLiteRepository(pool, pool)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond).Add(-time.Minute)
	require.NoError(t, r.CreateWorkspace(ctx, &models.Workspace{ID: "composition-workspace", Name: "Synthetic", OwnerID: u.ID}))
	_, err = db.Exec(`INSERT INTO tasks(id,workspace_id,title,created_at,updated_at) VALUES ('composition-task','composition-workspace','Synthetic',?,?)`, now, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = db.Exec(`INSERT INTO task_sessions(id,task_id,queue_incarnation_id,started_at,updated_at) VALUES ('composition-session','composition-task','synthetic-incarnation',?,?)`, now, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, r.CreateTurn(ctx, &models.Turn{ID: "composition-turn", TaskID: "composition-task", TaskSessionID: "composition-session", StartedAt: now}))
	q := ownanswer.Question{ID: "synthetic-q", Title: "Synthetic", Prompt: "Synthetic choice?", Options: []ownanswer.Option{{ID: "a", Label: "A"}, {ID: "b", Label: "B"}}}
	qm := &models.Message{ID: "composition-question", TaskID: "composition-task", TaskSessionID: "composition-session", TurnID: "composition-turn", Type: models.MessageTypeClarificationRequest, AuthorType: models.MessageAuthorAgent, Content: "Synthetic question", RequestsInput: true, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Metadata: map[string]any{"question": q, "question_id": q.ID, "pending_id": "synthetic-pending", "status": "pending", "agent_disconnected": true}}
	require.NoError(t, r.CreateMessage(ctx, qm))
	am := &models.Message{ID: "composition-answer", TaskID: qm.TaskID, TaskSessionID: qm.TaskSessionID, TurnID: qm.TurnID, Type: models.MessageTypeMessage, AuthorType: models.MessageAuthorUser, Content: "Synthetic comments without historical question linkage.", CreatedAt: now.Add(time.Second), UpdatedAt: now.Add(time.Second), Metadata: map[string]any{"client_message_request_fingerprint": strings.Repeat("a", 64)}}
	require.NoError(t, r.CreateMessage(ctx, am))
	storedQuestion, err := r.GetMessage(ctx, qm.ID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	raw, err := json.Marshal(storedQuestion.Metadata["question"])
	require.NoError(t, err)
	b := ownanswer.OwnAnswerBinding{WorkspaceID: "composition-workspace", TaskID: qm.TaskID, SessionID: qm.TaskSessionID, QuestionID: q.ID, PendingID: "synthetic-pending", QuestionMessageID: qm.ID, QuestionSHA256: ownanswer.OwnAnswerDigest(raw), AnswerMessageID: am.ID, AnswerSHA256: ownanswer.OwnAnswerDigest([]byte(am.Content))}
	// Same-session unrelated content and ordered queue state must survive the flow.
	fact := *am
	fact.ID = "unrelated-fact"
	fact.Content = "Synthetic unrelated fact"
	fact.CreatedAt = am.CreatedAt.Add(time.Second)
	fact.UpdatedAt = fact.CreatedAt
	require.NoError(t, r.CreateMessage(ctx, &fact))
	independent := *qm
	independent.ID = "unrelated-question"
	independent.Metadata = maps.Clone(qm.Metadata)
	otherQuestion := q
	otherQuestion.ID, otherQuestion.Prompt = "unrelated-q", "An unrelated synthetic question?"
	independent.Metadata["question"] = otherQuestion
	independent.Metadata["question_id"] = otherQuestion.ID
	independent.Metadata["pending_id"] = "unrelated-pending"
	require.NoError(t, r.CreateMessage(ctx, &independent))
	_, err = db.Exec(`INSERT INTO queued_messages(id,session_id,task_id,position,content,queued_at,queued_by) VALUES ('retained-queue',?,?,0,'Retained synthetic FIFO entry',?,'user')`, b.SessionID, b.TaskID, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = db.Exec(`INSERT INTO queue_admission_receipts(task_id,session_id,session_incarnation_id,client_queue_id,request_fingerprint,accepted_queue_id,response_json,admitted_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`, b.TaskID, b.SessionID, "synthetic-incarnation", "unrelated-admission", strings.Repeat("b", 64), "retained-queue", `{"id":"retained-queue","content":"Unrelated synthetic admission"}`, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, r.UpsertExecutorRunning(ctx, &models.ExecutorRunning{ID: b.SessionID, TaskID: b.TaskID, SessionID: b.SessionID, AgentExecutionID: "synthetic-execution", Status: models.ExecutorRunningStatusRunning}))
	repo := &sqliterepo.SyntheticApprovalRepository{Repository: r, Binding: b}
	log := newTestLogger(t)
	svc := service.NewService(service.Repos{Workspaces: repo, Tasks: repo, TaskRepos: repo, Workflows: repo, Messages: repo, Turns: repo, Sessions: repo, GitSnapshots: repo, RepoEntities: repo, Executors: repo, Environments: repo, TaskEnvironments: repo, Reviews: repo}, nil, log, service.RepositoryDiscoveryConfig{})
	router := gin.New()
	router.Use(httpmw.Middleware(a))
	router.POST("/api/v1/tasks/:id/approval-link-grants", taskhandlers.SyntheticApprovalHandler(svc, repo, log, b))
	ordinary := gin.New()
	ordinary.Use(httpmw.Middleware(a))
	taskhandlers.RegisterTaskRoutes(ordinary, ws.NewDispatcher(), svc, nil, repo, nil, log)
	dispatcher := ws.NewDispatcher()
	mcphandlers.NewHandlers(svc, nil, clarification.NewStore(0), nil, nil, repo, repo, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, log).RegisterHandlers(dispatcher)
	transport := compositionTransport{BackendClient: NewDispatcherBackendClient(dispatcher, log), resolver: mcpscope.NewResolver(repo, a, func() bool { return true }, log), binding: b}
	s := New(transport, b.SessionID, b.TaskID, 10005, log, "", false, ModeTask)
	return &compositionFixture{repo: repo, auth: a, token: token, router: router, ordinary: ordinary, server: s}
}

func (f *compositionFixture) issue(t *testing.T, router *gin.Engine, credential, option string, bearer bool) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	body := map[string]any{"purpose": ownanswer.ApprovalLinkPurpose, "option_id": option}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(f.repo.Binding)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &body))
	raw, err = json.Marshal(body)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/tasks/"+f.repo.Binding.TaskID+"/approval-link-grants", strings.NewReader(string(raw)))
	if bearer {
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+credential)
	} else if credential != "" {
		req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: f.auth.CookieNameForRequest(req), Value: credential})
	}
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	return rec
}

func (f *compositionFixture) consume(t *testing.T, id, operation string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.Marshal(f.repo.Binding)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	args := map[string]any{}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &args))
	delete(args, "workspace_id")
	delete(args, "task_id")
	delete(args, "session_id")
	args["approval_link_grant_id"] = id
	args["approval_link_operation_id"] = operation
	return callTool(t, f.server, ownAnswerToolName, args).IsError
}

func compositionSnapshot(t *testing.T, f *compositionFixture) map[string]string {
	t.Helper()
	out := map[string]string{}
	for _, table := range []string{"tasks", "workspaces", "task_sessions", "task_session_turns", "executors_running", "task_session_messages", "queued_messages", "queue_admission_receipts", "own_answer_approval_link_grants"} {
		rows, err := f.repo.DB().Query("SELECT * FROM " + table + " ORDER BY 1")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		cols, err := rows.Columns()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		all := []map[string]any{}
		for rows.Next() {
			v := make([]any, len(cols))
			p := make([]any, len(cols))
			for i := range v {
				p[i] = &v[i]
			}
			require.NoError(t, rows.Scan(p...))
			m := map[string]any{}
			for i, k := range cols {
				if b, ok := v[i].([]byte); ok {
					m[k] = string(b)
				} else {
					m[k] = v[i]
				}
			}
			all = append(all, m)
		}
		require.NoError(t, rows.Err())
		require.NoError(t, rows.Close())
		raw, err := json.Marshal(all)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		out[table] = string(raw)
	}
	return out
}

// Synthetic policy injection exists only in additive test compilation. These
// assertions do not claim original-hash production success or historical origin.
func TestApprovalLinkSyntheticComposition(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCompositionFixture(t)
	before := compositionSnapshot(t, f)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, credential, option string
		bearer                   bool
		want                     int
	}{{"anonymous", "", "a", false, 401}, {"forged-cookie", "forged", "a", false, 401}, {"bad-option", f.token, "foreign", false, 409}} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			require.Equal(t, tc.want, f.issue(t, f.router, tc.credential, tc.option, tc.bearer).Code)
			require.Equal(t, before, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
		})
	}
	id, ok := f.auth.ResolveSessionToken(context.Background(), f.token, "")
	require.True(t, ok)
	_, pat, err := f.auth.MintToken(context.Background(), id.UserID, "synthetic-pat", 1)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 403, f.issue(t, f.router, pat, "a", true).Code)
	require.Equal(t, before, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
	_, err = f.repo.DB().Exec(`UPDATE workspaces SET owner_id='foreign-owner' WHERE id=?`, f.repo.Binding.WorkspaceID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	foreignOwner := compositionSnapshot(t, f)
	require.Equal(t, 403, f.issue(t, f.router, f.token, "a", false).Code)
	require.Equal(t, foreignOwner, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
	_, err = f.repo.DB().Exec(`UPDATE workspaces SET owner_id=? WHERE id=?`, id.UserID, f.repo.Binding.WorkspaceID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, before, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
	// Even with the synthetic repository adapter, the normal HTTP selector is closed.
	require.Equal(t, 403, f.issue(t, f.ordinary, f.token, "a", false).Code)
	trusted := authn.WithIdentity(context.Background(), id)
	trusted = streams.WithMCPExecutionContext(trusted, streams.MCPExecutionContext{TaskID: f.repo.Binding.TaskID, SessionID: f.repo.Binding.SessionID, ExecutionID: "synthetic-execution"})
	_, err = f.repo.Repository.CreateApprovalLinkGrant(trusted, ownanswer.ApprovalLinkRequest{OwnAnswerBinding: f.repo.Binding, OptionID: "a"})
	require.Error(t, err)
	_, _, err = f.repo.Repository.ConsumeApprovalLinkGrant(trusted, f.repo.Binding, "foreign", "synthetic-operation", "synthetic-incarnation")
	require.Error(t, err)
	rec := f.issue(t, f.router, f.token, "a", false)
	require.Equal(t, 201, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	var g ownanswer.ApprovalLinkGrant
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &g))
	require.Equal(t, id.UserID, g.CreatorUserID)
	require.Equal(t, id.SessionID, g.CreatorSessionID)
	issued := compositionSnapshot(t, f)
	for table, value := range before {
		if table != "own_answer_approval_link_grants" {
			require.Equal(t, value, issued[table], table)
		}
	}
	require.True(t, f.consume(t, g.ID, ""))
	require.Equal(t, issued, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
	// Fail after grant CAS: grant consumption and both message writes must roll back.
	_, err = f.repo.DB().Exec(`CREATE TRIGGER synthetic_abort_link BEFORE UPDATE ON task_session_messages BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'synthetic rollback'); END`)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, f.consume(t, g.ID, "synthetic-operation"))
	require.Equal(t, issued, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
	_, err = f.repo.DB().Exec(`DROP TRIGGER synthetic_abort_link`)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, f.consume(t, g.ID, "synthetic-operation"))
	settled := compositionSnapshot(t, f)
	for _, table := range []string{"tasks", "workspaces", "task_sessions", "task_session_turns", "executors_running", "queued_messages", "queue_admission_receipts"} {
		require.Equal(t, before[table], settled[table], table)
	}
	q, err := f.repo.GetMessage(context.Background(), f.repo.Binding.QuestionMessageID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "answered", q.Metadata["status"])
	a, err := f.repo.GetMessage(context.Background(), f.repo.Binding.AnswerMessageID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "Synthetic comments without historical question linkage.", a.Content)
	require.NotNil(t, a.Metadata[ownanswer.OwnAnswerBindingKey])
	assertCompositionMessagePreservation(t, before["task_session_messages"], settled["task_session_messages"], f.repo.Binding)
	fact, err := f.repo.GetMessage(context.Background(), "unrelated-fact")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "Synthetic unrelated fact", fact.Content)
	require.False(t, f.consume(t, g.ID, "synthetic-operation"))
	require.Equal(t, settled, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
	require.True(t, f.consume(t, g.ID, "conflicting-operation"))
	require.Equal(t, settled, compositionSnapshot(t, f))
}

func assertCompositionMessagePreservation(t *testing.T, before, after string, b ownanswer.OwnAnswerBinding) {
	t.Helper()
	var original, settled []map[string]any
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(before), &original))
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(after), &settled))
	require.Len(t, settled, len(original))
	for i, row := range settled {
		id := row["id"]
		if id != b.QuestionMessageID && id != b.AnswerMessageID {
			require.Equal(t, original[i], row, "unrelated message must remain byte-identical")
			continue
		}
		var oldMeta, newMeta map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(original[i]["metadata"].(string)), &oldMeta))
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(row["metadata"].(string)), &newMeta))
		if id == b.QuestionMessageID {
			require.Equal(t, "answered", newMeta["status"])
			require.NotNil(t, newMeta["response"])
			require.NotNil(t, newMeta[ownanswer.OwnAnswerReceiptKey])
			delete(newMeta, "response")
			delete(newMeta, ownanswer.OwnAnswerReceiptKey)
			newMeta["status"] = oldMeta["status"]
		} else {
			require.NotNil(t, newMeta[ownanswer.OwnAnswerBindingKey])
			delete(newMeta, ownanswer.OwnAnswerBindingKey)
		}
		require.Equal(t, oldMeta, newMeta, "only settlement metadata may change")
		delete(row, "metadata")
		delete(original[i], "metadata")
		delete(row, "updated_at")
		delete(original[i], "updated_at")
		require.Equal(t, original[i], row, "all original message bytes/identity/timestamps except settlement updated_at remain unchanged")
	}
}
